message: `if` is outside kapsel's shell subset and is refused: not in the subset
help: rewrite it with pipes, redirects, `&&`, `||`, `;`, quoting, `$(...)` and `for`/`while`/`until` only
notes: kapsel runs a small, fully parsed subset of POSIX sh; anything outside it is refused instead of guessed at (REQ-KS-010)
